## What This Vault IS

This is a **spec-driven engineering documentation vault**. Every note is either:
- A product specification (FEAT-XX)
- An architectural decision record (ADR-XXX)
- A data flow / logic document
- A design system artifact
- A gotcha / incident record
- A process standard

The vault enforces the **Doc-to-Code** principle: no code is written without an approved spec + ADR.

## ADR Range

ADR-057 through ADR-075 (19 records). Key ones:

| ADR | Decision |
|---|---|
| ADR-057 | POS Mobile = Static HTML, not Next.js (cold start avoidance) |
| ADR-060 | Modular architecture — `src/modules/` |
| ADR-062 | Obsidian vault (`docs/`) as documentation SSOT |
| ADR-064 | Doc-to-Code workflow — spec must precede implementation |
| ADR-068 | 6-role persona RBAC (OWNER, MANAGER, SALES, KITCHEN, FINANCE, STAFF) |
| ADR-070 | Master-Detail navigation shell (Topbar + contextual Sidebar) |
| ADR-073 | CLAUDE.md = lean navigator; details live in vault |
| ADR-075 | ERP standard ID naming convention |

⚠️ Two files share ADR-071 prefix (numbering conflict to investigate).

## Naming Conventions

| Type | Pattern | Example |
|---|---|---|
| ADR | `ADR-{NNN}-{slug}.md` | `ADR-068-persona-based-rbac.md` |
| Feature Spec | `FEAT{NN}-{MODULE}.md` | `FEAT06-POS.md` |
| Data Flow | `{module}.md` in `data-flows/` | `crm.md` |
| Gotcha | `{topic}.md` or `G-{CODE}-{NN}.md` | `multi-tenant.md` |
| Incident | `INCIDENT-{YYYY-MM-DD}-{SLUG}.md` | `INCIDENT-2026-04-03-BUILD-FAILURE.md` |
| Decision log | Appended entries in `decisions/log.md` | — |

---

## File Header Standard

Every `.md` file in this vault MUST start with:
```
# Created At: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss +07:00 (vX.Y.Z)
# Previous version: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss +07:00 (vX.Y.Z)
# Last Updated: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss +07:00 (vX.Y.Z)
```
Timezone: Thailand `+07:00` always.

---

## Auto-Save Rules

Claude should auto-save **without asking**:
- New ADR → `decisions/adrs/ADR-{NNN}-{slug}.md` + entry in `decisions/log.md` + entry in `log.md`
- New feature spec → `product/specs/FEAT{NN}-{MODULE}.md`
- Gotcha discovered → appropriate file in `gotchas/`
- Any new vault note → update `index.md`, append to `log.md`

Claude should **ask before**:
- Modifying any APPROVED spec or ACCEPTED ADR
- Archiving or deleting any document
- Changing `decisions/log.md` (append only)

---

## Propagation Rules

| Event | Also update |
|---|---|
| New ADR created | `decisions/log.md` (append entry), `index.md`, `log.md` |
| Spec status changes | `decisions/log.md` if it triggers a decision, `log.md` |
| New gotcha | `gotchas/README.md` (add to index), `log.md` |
| New feature spec | `product/PRODUCT_NAVIGATOR.md` reference, `index.md`, `log.md` |
| Any vault write | `log.md` (append timestamped entry) |
| New note created | `index.md` (add to catalog) |

- `.obsidian/` — Obsidian config. Never modify.
- `decisions/log.md` — Append only. Never rewrite or delete entries.
- `log.md` — Append only. Never rewrite or delete entries.
